sloka: भार्गवश्च्यवनो नाम हिमवन्तमुपाश्रित: ।तमृषिं समुपागम्य कालिन्दी त्वभ्यवादयत् ॥ २.११०.१८॥
transliteration: bhārgavaścyavano nāma himavantamupāśrita: ।tamṛṣiṁ samupāgamya kālindī tvabhyavādayat ॥ 2.110.18॥

translations.english: Both his wives became pregnant. It is said that one of them gave the other poison (with the motive) to destroy the embryo.
